command:
set -eu
UUID=$(blkid -s UUID -o value /dev/vg_data/lv_data)
cat > /usr/local/sbin/setup-data-lvm-loops <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
attach_loop() {
    dev=$1
    img=$2
    current=$(losetup -j "$img" | sed -n '1{s/:.*//;p;}')
    if [ -n "$current" ]; then
        [ "$current" = "$dev" ] || { echo "$img already attached to $current, expected $dev" >&2; exit 1; }
        return 0
    fi
    if losetup "$dev" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "$dev already has an unexpected backing file" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
    losetup "$dev" "$img"
}
attach_loop /dev/loop0 /var/lib/lvm-loop/data-pv1.img
attach_loop /dev/loop1 /var/lib/lvm-loop/data-pv2.img
/sbin/pvscan --cache
/sbin/vgchange -ay vg_data
ANTRIEB_EOF
chmod 0755 /usr/local/sbin/setup-data-lvm-loops
cat > /etc/systemd/system/lvm-loop-setup.service <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Attach persistent loop devices for the data LVM volume
DefaultDependencies=no
After=systemd-udev-trigger.service

ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/setup-data-lvm-loops
RemainAfterExit=yes

[Install]
